create_LayerSelect_soft: create a LayerSelect module with soft selection for weighting residual connections in a neural network
create_LayerSelect_hard: create a LayerSelect module with hard selection for selecting residual connections using Gumbel-Sigmoid sampling
sample_LayerSelect: sample layer logits using the LayerSelect sample method with a specified logit index
forward_LayerSelect: forward a layer index through LayerSelect to retrieve the precomputed sample for that layer
review_gumbel_sigmoid: review the LayerSelect _gumbel_sigmoid method that implements Gumbel-Sigmoid sampling with straight-through estimation
